scripts.check: pnpm check:static && pnpm test:desktop && pnpm test:ci
scripts.check:static: pnpm -r exec tsc --noEmit && eslint . && node scripts/license-scan.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs
scripts.check:gate: pnpm check:static && pnpm audit:advisories && pnpm test:desktop && pnpm test:ci:serial
scripts.test:ci: vitest run --exclude server/src/__tests__/load.test.ts && vitest run server/src/__tests__/load.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scripts.test:ci:serial: vitest run --exclude server/src/__tests__/load.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && vitest run server/src/__tests__/load.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
